about:
MEI Industrial Solutions operates from Southbridge, Massachusetts, where it runs a fabrication facility and retail metal yard on Ashland Avenue. The business was formerly known as Accurate Metal Sales & Fabrication before adopting its current name.

The company provides custom metal fabrication, including sub-assemblies, weldments, structural repairs, and complex weldments, along with rigging and installation of finished products. Its shop is equipped with a high-definition plasma table cutting up to 1.5-inch mild steel, hydraulic shear, vertical band saw, radial arm drill, press brake, roll forming equipment, an ironworker, and multiple MIG, TIG, and stick welding machines. In-house design services use SolidWorks and AutoCAD to produce conceptual and engineered blueprints, and the staff performs cutting, drilling, grinding, beveling, oxyacetylene and plasma torch cutting, jigging, fit-up, and assembly.

MEI serves the general public through retail metal sales, as well as commercial construction firms, municipalities, residential general contractors, and military and defense contracts. Its inventory includes a wide range of structural steel shapes, plate, tubing, and pipe in standard sizes.

The company emphasizes that all its welders hold AWS D1.1 structural certification and MIL certification for defense work, and it uses CNC plasma cutting to meet exact requirements and delivery deadlines. On-site fabrication and installation services are also available.
